verdict.rationale: Kit's official remote MCP server lets an AI client read live account data, including subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. The documented V4 API adds per-broadcast stats, batch stats across a page of broadcasts, per-link click performance, and account-level 90-day email and growth stats, which together let an agent pull the program and report on performance. missing for 10: no documented API/MCP access to Visual Automation workflows beyond sequences, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent producing such a report.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: The Kit MCP is a remote MCP server that exposes a creator's Kit account — subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments, and more — to MCP-compatible AI clients.
the Kit MCP gives an AI client the ability to read and write live account data on the creator's behalf.
Returns delivery and engagement stats for a single broadcast: recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, their corresponding rates, plus the sending `status` and `progress`.
Useful for seeing which calls to action actually drove engagement.
Returns account-level email performance for the last 90 days: `sent`, `opened`, and `clicked` counts plus open, click, unsubscribe, and bounce rates
